notes: Data-driven UE macro semantics for the syntax layer. 'match' is an exact name or a prefix ending in '*'; the first matching entry wins.

macroDocs.UCLASS: Marks a class as a UObject class for the reflection system (UHT). Needs GENERATED_BODY() and the .generated.h include.
macroDocs.USTRUCT: Marks a struct for the reflection system (UHT). Needs GENERATED_BODY().
macroDocs.UENUM: Marks an enum for the reflection system (UHT); use 'enum class E : uint8' for Blueprint types.
macroDocs.UINTERFACE: Declares the UObject side (UFoo) of an interface; the native side is IFoo with GENERATED_BODY().
macroDocs.UFUNCTION: Exposes a member function to the reflection system: Blueprints, RPCs, console commands, timers and delegates.
macroDocs.UPROPERTY: Exposes a member variable to the reflection system: garbage collection, serialization, Details panel, Blueprints and replication.
macroDocs.UMETA: Metadata of an enum value (DisplayName, Hidden, ToolTip).
macroDocs.UPARAM: Specifiers of a UFUNCTION parameter (ref, DisplayName).
macroDocs.UDELEGATE: Metadata of a dynamic delegate signature.
macroDocs.GENERATED_BODY: Injects the UHT-generated boilerplate: StaticClass(), Super, ThisClass, constructors and reflection glue.
macroDocs.GENERATED_UCLASS_BODY: Legacy GENERATED_BODY that also declares the FObjectInitializer constructor and switches to public access.
macroDocs.UE_LOG: UE_LOG(Category, Verbosity, TEXT("Format"), ...): writes a formatted message to the log.
macroDocs.check: check(Expr): asserts in non-shipping builds; the expression is not evaluated in shipping.
macroDocs.ensure: ensure(Expr): reports (once) a non-fatal assertion and returns the value of Expr.
